content:
maria: Heads-up — kicking off rollout v4.2.1 to eu-west in the 23:00 UTC change window. Small canary (5%) at 23:05, then ramp to 50% at 23:20 if green. Please watch these checks: p95 latency, 5xx rate, embedding QPS, and synthetic heartbeat failures. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/4.2.1 :sparkles:

jamal: copying checklist. I've pre-wired the traffic tag `v4-2-1-canary` and added a routing pin for legacy-compat fallback. I'll keep the pin handy to revert to `v4-1-9` if metrics cross thresholds.

sree: I'll run quick smoke after canary spins up. curl smoke command below for ops: 
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_KEY" 
  -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' https://eu1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate | jq .status
```

olivia: Observability notes: dashboards linked in the deployment playbook. Key panels: `deploy/latency/p95`, `deploy/errors/5xx_rate`, `kvcache/hit_ratio`, `synthetic/heartbeat-eu-west`. I'm enabling denser sampling for the next 30m.

deploy-bot: canary start triggered by @maria at 23:05 UTC. canary_id=canary-2026-10-12-01. Routing: 5% traffic -> v4-2-1-canary. Monitoring hooks active.

slo-bot: ALERT (automated): synthetic-heartbeat-eu-west spiked to 3 failures/min at 23:08 UTC. Current baseline is 0.1/min. Tagging thread.

maria: noted. Jamal — check infra traces for spike source (node vs deployment). Sree — hold on ramp until we confirm. If p95 latency > 200ms over 2 windows or 5xx_rate > 0.5% we pause and roll back.

jamal: looking through traces now — seeing elevated KV cache eviction churn on a subset of pods, causing increased tail latency. Rolling a config tweak to reduce GC aggressiveness on the canary pool. Pushing patch -> `canary-pool/gc=low`.

olivia: Dashboard shows p95 back down after the tweak but synthetic still intermittent. Heartbeat failures tied to one availability zone (eu-west-2b). Suggest pinning traffic away from that AZ while we triage.

maria: agree. Jamal — can you set AZ routing override? Command: 
```json
POST /v1/routing/overrides
{ "scope":"canary-2026-10-12-01", "avoid_az": ["eu-west-2b"] }
```

jamal: done. Override applied. Traffic shifted off eu-west-2b for the canary. Monitoring sampling increased.

deploy-bot: ramp to 20% scheduled at 23:20 UTC (on hold per manual pause).

maria: decision update — hold the 20% ramp for 15m while we watch. If no further heartbeat failures and p95 stays <200ms, proceed to 50%. If synthetic or 5xx returns we rollback to v4-1-9 and notify customers. :warning:

sree: smoke OK from my side after AZ override: returned status OK and latency ~120ms.

olivia: p95 steady at 130ms, 5xx_rate 0.12%. Synthetic heartbeat normalized to baseline.

maria: good. proceeding with controlled ramp to 50% at 23:25. Jamal — keep the pin and AZ override live for another 30m.

jamal: will keep it for 30m. I'll also tag the deploy with `needs-postmortem: false` unless anything else pops.

maria: if anyone wants to call an immediate rollback, react with :rotating_light:. Otherwise we'll continue monitoring.

olivia: :thumbsup:

sree: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: ramp to 50% complete at 23:26 UTC. canary_id=canary-2026-10-12-01. Monitoring hooks: OK.

maria: merging canary -> stable rollout at 23:40 UTC. Post-rollout smoke and summary in 30m. Thanks all for quick triage.

slo-bot: NOTE: Scheduled SLO snapshot will run at 00:00 UTC and will include this deployment window (watch for regression alerts).
